title: DFT energy calculations for Co-N4 models
action: Construct atomic models of (a) a pristine Co-N4 site embedded in a graphene layer and (b) the Co-N4-6r-c2 defect model (a Co-N4 moiety adjacent to a six-membered ring with a carbon vacancy) as described in the paper's computational methods. Perform DFT total-energy calculations for the clean slab and for adsorbed ORR intermediates (*OOH, *O, *OH) on each model. Save the computed total energies.
description: Intermediate step: the agent must run the full DFT pipeline (model construction, geometry optimizations, total-energy calculations) and record the resulting total energies of the clean slabs and intermediate-covered configurations in a CSV file for the next step.
output_schema: CSV with columns: model (string: 'pristine' or 'defect'), configuration (string: 'clean', 'OOH', 'O', 'OH'), total_energy_eV (float). The agent may include additional internal columns.

title: Free-energy analysis and working potential calculation
action: From the DFT energies in step_01_dft_energies, apply the computational hydrogen electrode (CHE) model to compute adsorption free energies for *OOH, *O, and *OH. Determine the working potential U for each model (the highest potential at which all elementary steps are downhill in free energy). Compute the free-energy change for the O2 → *OOH step at a fixed potential of 0.83 V vs. SHE for the defect model. Write the results as a JSON object with the required fields.
description: Scored artifact containing the computed working potentials and free-energy change. The load-bearing property ensures the agent must genuinely run the DFT step; a guess of these values will not satisfy the required trend and tolerance checks.
